statement: The market simultaneously sells "never crunch" absolutism and "100% resolved in 12 weeks" guarantees with testimonial inch-loss and before/after photos; the evidence base (2021–2023 skeptical SRs vs 2025–26 favourable-but-very-low-certainty NMAs; Gluppe 2023 curl-up-no-harm RCT) supports neither absolute.
evidence: Zhu 2025 / Bigdeli 2025 / Benjamin 2023 review positions; Gluppe et al. J Physiother 2023. Accessed 2026-09-17.
source: Authoring Wave 1 evidence review (review-positions synthesis; not a new review)
